fields.product_name_identifier: OrthoSpine Pedicle Screw System 6.5mm x 45mm (REF OS-6545)
fields.manufacturer_info:
Manufactured by:
BioSpine Implants Inc.
200 Orthopedic Way, Memphis, TN 38101, USA
fields.intended_purpose: Indicated for immobilization and stabilization of spinal segments in thoracic, lumbar, and sacral spine.
fields.device_description: Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy polyaxial spinal pedicle screw with dual-lead thread profile.
fields.warnings_precautions: Rx Only. Single use only. Do not reuse or resterilize. Use only with dedicated OrthoSpine instrumentation.
fields.instructions_for_use: Refer to OrthoSpine Surgical Technique Manual (STM-OS-004) for trajectory preparation and torque limits.
fields.storage_handling: Store in dry environment at ambient temperature. Keep within protective carton until point of surgery.
fields.sterilization_info: Sterilized by Gamma Radiation (R). Sterile barrier: Sealed blister tray.
fields.shelf_life_expiry: Shelf Life: 5 Years from date of irradiation. Expiration date on box label.
fields.symbols_descriptions: ISO 15223-1 symbols: Sterile R, Do Not Resterilize, Caution, Consult Instructions for Use, Rx Only.
